_doc: Motedis Aluprofil 20x20 I-Typ Nut 5: a 20 mm aluminium profile made to match item's Line 5 (profile-2020-item-5). Outer size, opening, slot depth, bore and the section figures are from Motedis' own data picture; what it does not print (the lip, the cavity's width, the corner radius) is item's figure or scaled off item's drawing, and says so. The drawn outline leaves out the rounds inside the grooves.
